Public Sector Workers Secure 18.3% Pay Rise in 5.2 Billion Euro Deal

Public sector workers earning the lowest wages in Ireland are set to receive an 18.3% pay increase as part of a new deal valued at 5.2 billion euros. The agreement aims to address wage disparities for lower-paid employees within the public sector.
